signalReconciliation.headline: The agent does not claim to know better. It reads across signals and shows where they conflict so planners can judge the contested calls.
signalReconciliation.simulationNote: External programme signals from D-Star, Maestria, and Matrix are simulated for this demo. Internal signals from POS velocity, trade inventory, and event calendar are genuinely computed from the data.

draftScenarios.name: Localise Ford parts to USMCA content
draftScenarios.description: Re-source castings and forgings into North America so Ford's parts meet USMCA regional value content and stay duty-free under a parts tariff. A localisation cost per piece replaces the tariff. This is the structural answer to the first scenario rather than a forecast of one.

draftScenarios.name: Aluminium surcharge doubles
draftScenarios.description: The per-kg aluminium surcharge doubles, as it did in 2022, on every aluminium-intensive part family. The move is largest on heavy, low-value parts and in the aftermarket, where garages respond to price.

draftScenarios.name: US 25% tariff on Mexican-built parts
draftScenarios.description: A 25% duty on Ford's parts built in San Luis Potosí, against the USMCA zero they enter at today. Ford buys direct, so Vectron's price is nearly all of the delivered cost and the tariff has no margin or tax layer to hide behind. Ford's build schedule barely moves; the cost lands as a commercial negotiation.
